title: Preserve external data during failed mutations

preflight.note: Registered before runtime changes on main 298828de6ae91f34dedd4f7cc6d98587f0959704 (tree 5fd33f98201f0ff313a199dc99ba74d0fb21ca8f). WI084 was the next canonical allocation; no competing WI084 reservation was found. PR15 and its dirty WI076 worktree/evidence were left untouched. Decision0040 governs stale-plan and transaction rollback semantics; the engine semantic-compatibility documentation mapping is an affected governance record. Reopened before runtime edits by coordinator review https://github.com/ForgeWireLabs/repopact-core/pull/34#issuecomment-7224414238: hard-link aliases and unsupported reparse points were not proven contained, and captured preimages/root states were not reconciled with original plan read facts before writes.

acceptance_criteria.text: Incomplete or ambiguous preimage capture fails closed before the first mutation write; regression tests prove external bytes remain unchanged.

Capture complete, consistent, repository-contained preimages under the mutation lock; distinguish absent paths from unreadable, failed enumeration, unsupported type, symlink/reparse, and inconsistent state, and reject before writes.

Rollback changes only transaction-owned after-state, preserves external and unowned bytes/directories, reports conflicts as recovery-required failures, and never reports success or false rolled_back when restoration is unproven.

Focused regression coverage verifies create/edit/transition success; capture failures; injected failures before and after writes/moves; external drift before operation zero and during apply; subtrees, unrelated content, and symlink/reparse outside sentinels.

Run and record focused tests, the required local validation profile and legacy comparator, dashboard reconciliation, canonical validation, and frozen-surface check while preserving plan identity/read-set/lock/stale checks/postvalidation/proposal semantics. Do not claim process-death, power-loss, or arbitrary uncooperative-writer recovery.

Reject multiply-linked regular files and unsupported reparse points at targeted roots, captured descendants, and rollback ownership rechecks; fail closed when link metadata is unavailable or unsupported. A same-volume hard-link outside sentinel remains byte-for-byte unchanged, with a host-supported junction/reparse negative case where available, and no new filesystem dependency is introduced.

Reconcile captured preimages and observed roots with original plan read facts and checked root states, reject unreadable or ambiguous observations as distinct from absence, and recheck applicable facts before the first write. Deterministic post-stale-check/pre-capture edits, direct file-read failure, captured-state mismatch, and exact rollback assertions prove fail-closed behavior while preserving external bytes.
